title: Optimistic Actor-Critic with Parametric Policies for Linear Markov Decision Processes
abstract: arXiv:2603.28595v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Although actor-critic methods have been successful in practice, their theoretical analyses have several limitations. Specifically, existing theoretical work either sidesteps the exploration problem by making strong assumptions or analyzes impractical methods with complicated algorithmic modifications. Moreover, the actor-critic methods analyzed for linear MDPs often employ natural policy gradient and define "implicit" policies through the accumulated critic estimates, rather than learning an explicitly parameterized actor. Such policies can be computationally expensive to sample from, making the environment interactions inefficient. To that end, we focus on the finite-horizon linear MDPs and propose an optimistic actor-critic framework that uses parametric log-linear policies. In particular, we introduce a tractable logit-matching regression objective for the actor. For the critic, we use approximate Thompson sampling via Langevin Mo

translated_title: 面向线性马尔可夫决策过程的参数化策略乐观演员-评论家算法
translated_abstract: 尽管演员-评论家方法在实践中取得了成功，但其理论分析存在若干局限性。具体而言，现有的理论工作要么通过做出强假设来回避探索问题，要么分析经过复杂算法修改后不实用的方法。此外，针对线性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）所分析的演员-评论家方法通常采用自然策略梯度，并通过累积的评论家估计来定义“隐式”策略，而不是学习显式参数化的演员。这类策略的采样在计算上可能代价高昂，导致与环境交互的效率低下。为此，我们聚焦于有限时域线性MDP，提出了一种使用参数化对数线性策略的乐观演员-评论家框架。特别地，我们为演员引入了一个易于处理的logit匹配回归目标。对于评论家，我们通过朗之万动力学（Langevin Mo...原文在此处截断）使用近似汤普森采样。
tldr: 该论文针对有限时域线性马尔可夫决策过程提出了使用参数化对数线性策略的乐观演员-评论家框架，通过引入可处理的logit匹配回归目标和基于朗之万动力学的近似汤普森采样，克服了现有演员-评论家方法在探索假设和隐式策略采样效率方面的理论局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimistic actor-critic framework with parametric log-linear policies for finite-horizon linear MDPs, introducing a tractable logit-matching regression objective for the actor and approximate Thompson sampling for the critic to overcome the theoretical limitations of existing methods regarding exploration assumptions and implicit policy sampling inefficiency.
